## pi-web-ui 0.6.2

This patch improves workspace clarity and recovery in the Web UI and desktop app.

- The “files involved in this conversation” list now confirms that each file exists in the selected workspace. Paths from other projects and deleted files no longer appear as shortcuts.
- Bash output distinguishes partial failures, keeps likely error lines visible when output is collapsed, and separates ordinary output from error lines. Long commands are easier to expand and read.
- The active project leads the sidebar, followed by recent activity. Nearby question markers merge into one mark, and the conversation file list groups actions with a separate filename and directory line.
- Project clicks switch workspaces without a duplicate toast. `/cwd` switches leave a centered event in the destination conversation. Other notice cards use a subtle gray border.
- A lost connection is shown clearly while the agent is working. The desktop app attempts to restart its local server after an unexpected exit.
- The shared status bar shows the running pi-web-ui version in both Web and Desktop.

The matching npm package is `@youweichen/pi-web-ui@0.6.2`. Desktop installers are built for macOS, Windows, and Linux. They are unsigned; macOS may require right-click → Open, and Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher prompt.
